  : Forward Deployed Engineer (Remote)

  **Type**

**The Role**

We’re hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer to work directly with the world’s leading AI labs and enterprises as a technical research and implementation partner. This role sits at the intersection of applied AI, ML infrastructure, data intelligence, and partner-facing product development.

You’ll help strategic partners define research directions, structure and curate high-quality data, implement ML and evaluation pipelines, and build the agentic systems that extend multi-turn agents and workflows in production. You should be comfortable moving between ambiguous research questions, technical architecture, hands-on engineering, and partner-facing execution.

**What You’ll Work On**

1. Work directly with leading AI labs and enterprise partners to define research goals, technical requirements, and project direction.

2. Build large-scale data intelligence systems for collecting, organizing, evaluating, and improving training and evaluation data.

3. Implement ML pipelines for data curation, model training, evaluation, experimentation, and continuous improvement.

4. Design data taxonomies, labeling systems, and quality frameworks that improve dataset structure, model performance, and research outcomes.

5. Develop LLM applications, including multi-agent systems, tool-using agents, RAG workflows, evaluation harnesses, and human-in-the-loop systems.

6. Partner with research and engineering teams to translate ambiguous AI problems into scoped technical projects and production systems.

7. Develop infrastructure for model inference, experimentation, evaluation, and deployment across frontier AI platforms.

8. Build systems that help partners move from one-off AI experiments to reliable, repeatable, multi-turn agent workflows.

9. Own systems across the full lifecycle, including discovery, architecture, implementation, deployment, reliability, iteration, and partner success.

**What We're Looking For**

1. Able to operate independently in ambiguous, partner-facing settings with strong technical and product ownership.

2. Strong Python engineer with experience building and shipping production systems end to end.

3. Experience working with LLMs, agentic systems, multi-turn workflows, tool use, RAG, or AI automation.

4. Built or maintained data pipelines, ML infrastructure, evaluation systems, or research workflows.

5. Strong understanding of data quality, taxonomy design, labeling workflows, and dataset curation for AI systems.

6. Comfortable working directly with technical partners, researchers, founders, and enterprise stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

1. Background at a startup, AI infrastructure company, applied AI company, or research-focused engineering team.

2. Experience building systems for multi-turn agents, agent evaluation, workflow automation, or human-in-the-loop AI.

3. Experience designing data taxonomies, annotation systems, evaluation rubrics, or dataset quality pipelines.

4. Experience acting as a technical partner to external customers, research teams, or strategic enterprise accounts.

5. Familiarity with modern LLM tooling, agent frameworks, model evaluation stacks, and ML experimentation platforms.

**About Crunchyroll**
Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love.
  
  
Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Software Engineer II on the Mobile Monetization team, you will contribute to the improvement of end-to-end monetization experiences on Crunchyroll’s Android and Apple apps. Our goal is to increase subscription and add-on revenue while preserving fan trust and product quality. You will take ownership of key features and improvements, ensuring high-quality code, performance, and user experience. You'll collaborate with Engineering, Product, Design, and Program Management to deliver scalable and reliable solutions that delight millions of anime fans. Contribute to the design and implementation of Android features that enhance our streaming apps across supported platforms.
  
  

* Collaborate on solutions that improve code maintainability, user experience, and overall app performance.
* Identify technical debt, performance bottlenecks, or reliability issues, and work with engineering leadership and your team to address them.
* Maintain high standards for code quality and engineering best practices across the Android stack.
* Participate in design discussions and code reviews, contributing to a strong team culture of technical excellence.
* Support operational excellence through sustainable on-call practices and a focus on reducing long-term toil.
* Stay current with industry trends, tools, and best practices in Android development to ensure our apps remain competitive and modern.

This is a hybrid role (3 days in the office per week) that reports to an Engineering Manager, Mobile Monetization in the Fan Experience Engineering Organization. We are considering applicants for the location of San Francisco.
  
  
**Core Areas of Responsibility**

* Implement Android features that directly impact the Crunchyroll user experience across multiple platforms.
* Collaborate cross-functionally in technical solutions to align with product goals and customer needs.
* Be responsible for feature development as an owner, with a focus on quality, performance, and scalability.
* Contribute to team operations, including code reviews, on-call support, and technical planning.
* Continuously seek opportunities to improve engineering practices, reduce tech debt, and enhance development efficiency.

**About You**
We get excited about candidates, like you, because…
  
  

* You have 2+ years of experience developing Android applications using Kotlin.
* You have hands-on experience building production apps with Jetpack libraries such as Compose.
* You have a working knowledge of testing frameworks like Espresso and understand the value of unit, integration, and E2E testing.
* You are familiar with Android architecture patterns and have applied them to create maintainable and scalable codebases.
* You have contributed to consumer-facing mobile applications at scale, ideally with multimedia or streaming experiences.
* You have experience debugging complex issues and navigating large, modular codebases using established engineering best practices.
* You possess a strong grasp of Git workflows and are comfortable working in modern CI/CD practices.
* You are familiar with Agile methodologies and working within a cross-functional team setup.
* You have participated in an on-call rotation and understand what it means to build resilient systems that reduce operational burden over time.
* You are test-driven and have experience using agentic tools to enhance development efficiency.

**About The Team**
The Fan Experience Engineering Organization is a global team of engineers passionate about delivering high-quality experiences across all of Crunchyroll’s supported platforms, including Apple, Android, Roku, and more. Our Mobile Monetization team plays a key role in contributing towards revenue and reducing churn through better lifecycle management. We work closely with cross-functional partners to develop scalable features that serve millions of anime fans around the world. The work we do is front and center to Crunchyroll’s success and directly contributes to the growth of our platform and our audience.
  
  
Why you will love working at Crunchyroll

FanDuel is actively seeking a Software Engineer - Salesforce Tester to ensure proper quality, reliability and functionality of the FanDuel Salesforce environment. Additionally, they will work on implementing automated test scripts, reducing testing time and improving efficiency. This exciting opportunity will help increase user satisfaction and application performance for FanDuel customers by identifying and documenting defects, errors, and inconsistencies.
In addition to the specific responsibilities outlined above, employees may be required to perform other such duties as assigned by the Company. This ensures operational flexibility and allows the Company to meet evolving business needs.

In your role as a Software Engineer - Salesforce Tester, you will have the following responsibilities:
Ability to write and execute comprehensive test plans and test cases.
Perform Functional testing of the feature to meet the lowest acceptance criteria.

**About The Role**
Our software team is growing, and we are looking for talented engineers to join us and be instrumental to one of the following areas: Data Platform, Simulation, and Technical Infrastructure.
  
  

* Data Platform: The Data Platform serves as a comprehensive management system for Nuro AI Driver's data, labels, and metrics, facilitating seamless access functionality. The team focuses on data annotation across various domains, including 2D/3D perception, mapping, behavior trajectory, and language/text. It also handles data ingestion and mining, employing methods such as heuristics and embedding search. Additionally, the platform supports the autonomy evaluation infrastructure by providing detailed introspection.
* Simulation: The Simulation team builds the simulator that allows us to develop and test our autonomous driving technology in a virtual setting. We work on the core simulator and simulation frameworks, sensor simulation, scenario generation, and solutions that combine real-world data with synthetic techniques to push the boundaries of what can be simulated, collaborating closely with teams across Autonomy and AI Platform to allow us to simulate realistically and reliably at scale.
* Technical Infrastructure: this group owns few fundamental services for entire engineering organizations: generic compute platform to host mission-critical workflows such as data processing and simulation, storage management service which manages hundreds of PB of data, cloud infrastructure serves as IaaC which provisions and maintains all cloud resources, engineering productivity provides tools such as build and CI/CD to make engineering work more efficient.
